name: The Blockade Network
description:
The Blockcade is a cross-play Minecraft network for Java and Bedrock players.

LifeSteal: Kill players to steal their hearts, lose them all and you're out. Custom crates, kits, jobs, skills, auctions and events.

Factions: Build your faction, raid your enemies and control the warzone. Custom enchants, airdrops, envoys and a full economy.

Vote daily for a free Vote Key, and join our community at theblockcade.com!
